name: 34210 · Bradenton, FL
findings: ZIP 34210 (Bradenton) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34210 (Bradenton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
